h1: Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin Phichit — Steps from the Train, Spacious Balcony Rooms at an Easy Price
intro: Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin is a budget hotel in the Taphan Hin district of Phichit Province on Chomtireevet Road, about a 1-minute walk (roughly 150 m) to Taphan Hin railway station · It has 60 rooms, all with balconies, plus an elevator, free parking and free Wi-Fi · What real guest reviews consistently mention is that the rooms are spacious and cleaner than the price suggests, with friendly staff, all from around ฿450/night — making it a solid value pick for anyone on business in Taphan Hin or traveling by train who wants a stay right by the station.

body.html: Roseinn Taphanhin is a hotel in the Taphan Hin district that business travelers and train passengers pick often · The thing real reviews agree on is that the rooms are spacious and cleaner than the price suggests, in a spot right by Taphan Hin railway station — the hotel is on Chomtireevet Road, only about 150 m from the station, a one-minute walk · There's free parking and free Wi-Fi, so it works whether you drive in or step off the train and walk straight over.

The rooms are where many reviews land their praise · Each has air conditioning, a fridge, a TV, a hot-water heater, and a balcony, plus a private bathroom · Reviews say the rooms are roomy, the AC cold, the water pressure strong, and many rooms feel fairly new · The building has an elevator, so there's no hauling bags up stairs · With around 60 rooms, it handles both one-night stops and events, since the property also has a banquet space.

For breakfast, the hotel serves a buffet breakfast (charged separately from the room) in its dining room in the morning · Reviews say it's fine for the price · If you want other meals, the Taphan Hin location helps a lot — there are plenty of restaurants and food carts around the railway station, especially in the early morning when the food stalls get busy, just a few steps from the hotel.

"Spacious, clean room with a new air conditioner and strong hot water, an elevator, and smiling staff · Better value than expected, and the train station is just a one-minute walk · Breakfast included, good service."

To be straight about it, this is a budget hotel and the building does show its age · Some reviews feel the hallways are a bit dark and quiet to the point of seeming deserted · A few rooms have a musty smell or the odd mosquito · And because the AC runs cold, some guests say they had to shift the bed or bedding to dodge the draft at night · If you're hoping for a brand-new property or a luxe feel, this won't be it — but if your brief is a spacious, clean room next to the train station for around four hundred baht, it does the job well.

One more thing to know: Taphan Hin is a small district, not Phichit town itself · If your main destination is Bueng Si Fai or the Phichit town area, allow about 35–40 minutes' drive into the city · But if your business is in Taphan Hin, or you're traveling on the northern rail line and want a stay by the station, this location is very convenient · Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is 12:00, with a 24-hour front desk, so late arrivals are no problem.

Overall, Roseinn Taphanhin scores around 8.3 out of 10 on Trip.com and is among the top stays in the Taphan Hin area · It's not new or fancy, but its strengths — spacious, clean rooms, balconies in every room, an elevator, a location right by the train station, and a wallet-friendly price — make it a worthwhile pick for business visitors, train travelers, or anyone passing through who wants a good room without paying much.

honestSummary: Roseinn Taphanhin is a budget hotel that delivers spacious, clean rooms with balconies, right by Taphan Hin railway station — strong on value, room size, and walking distance to the station · The trade-off is an aging building with somewhat dark hallways, set in Taphan Hin district away from Phichit town.
honestChecks: If your main destination is Phichit town or Bueng Si Fai — this is in Taphan Hin district, about a 35–40 minute drive into the city → for a stay in town, look at The Nest Hotel or Phichit Plaza.
If you expect a brand-new property or a luxe feel — the building shows its age and the hallways are a bit dark → here the focus is spacious, clean, good-value rooms rather than polish.
If you're sensitive to temperature or smells — the AC runs cold and a few rooms can be musty or have mosquitoes → ask to change rooms or adjust the AC at the 24-hour front desk.

faq.q: Where is Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin, and is it near the train station?
faq.a: Roseinn Taphanhin is at 57 Chomtireevet Road, Taphan Hin Subdistrict, Taphan Hin District, Phichit Province · It's right by Taphan Hin railway station, about 150 m away — roughly a 1-minute walk · It's ideal for travelers on the northern rail line or anyone on business in the Taphan Hin area.

faq.q: How much does Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿450/night for a Deluxe Room · There are larger Studio and Suite rooms at roughly ฿600–850 · Every room has a balcony, AC, a fridge, a TV and a hot-water heater · Prices vary by date, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin have parking, an elevator and Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes to all · Free parking, free Wi-Fi, and an elevator, so there's no hauling bags up stairs · There's a 24-hour front desk, so late check-ins are fine — convenient whether you drive in or arrive by train.

faq.q: What are the rooms at Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin like — are they clean?
faq.a: Real reviews consistently say the rooms are spacious and cleaner than the price suggests, with new AC and strong hot water, and every room has a balcony · The building does show its age and the hallways are a bit dark; a few rooms can be musty or have mosquitoes · If concerned, ask to change rooms at the 24-hour front desk.

faq.q: Does Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin serve breakfast?
faq.a: Yes · it's a buffet breakfast, charged separately from the room, served in the hotel's dining room · Reviews say it's fine for the price · For more options, there are plenty of restaurants and food carts around the station, especially in the early morning.

faq.q: Who is Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin best for?
faq.a: It suits business visitors in Taphan Hin, train travelers, or anyone passing through who wants a spacious, clean room by the station at a low price · If your main destination is Phichit town or Bueng Si Fai, allow a 35–40 minute drive into the city · For a stay in town, consider The Nest Hotel or Phichit Plaza.
